box_rule.center: predictor-only distinct-class representative; oracle uses modeled native whole-ligand heavy-atom centroid
box_rule.review_of_protocol_40A_limit: Source-only radius bound gives 1GNY side41A before any new docking; permit at most42A uniformly, with all other cases <=40A
box_rule.side_A: ceil(max(24,2*R+16)), R=max heavy-atom distance from independent input conformer centroid

budget_interpretation: Top1 predicts with onebox versus one oraclebox, same per-box settings. Top5 permits up to5predicted boxes; total CPU is not matched to one oraclebox, so no equal-time superiority claim.
cohort_role: development; existing site outcomes known; no held-out or prospective confirmatory claim
failure_policy: Retain all27 workflow conditions; reference-rejected cases cannot estimate atomic accuracy; all method/preparation failures among atomic-eligible cases are zero workflow successes. 1QFO graph preparation failure retained, no repair authorized.
ligand_policy: Archived independently embedded graph/stereo-validated PDBQT; remove old centroid translation; preserve internal geometry and orientation; no native-coordinate conformer or pose input

pose_endpoints.full_vs_core: Separate complete-ligand and source-qualified modeled-core summaries; do not call core recovery whole-ligand recovery

purpose: Paired predicted-site and oracle-site Vina development pose recovery under separately frozen atomic-reference scopes
ranking: Within each seed and site budget, pool retained poses by Vina score ascending, candidate class rank ascending, then within-box model rank; preserve all identities

receptor_policy.model: dry rigid protein-only; metals/waters/glycans removed uniformly in predictor inputs; preserved whole-chain covalent identities
receptor_policy.selection: all whole protein chains with any heavy atom within6A Euclidean distance of the closed search box

statistics: Average3seeds withincondition; paired development summaries. Separate full/core strata. Existing complexes not independent held-out families; no population reliability certification.
